title: Text: DET Mike Russell ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: You know anything about this Greene deal
He did terrible, ignored every one of my texts even when I had info
And now I'm supposed to cover for his ass again
Im too close with Al, I need to get out of here. It's impeding my ability to do my job
I keep stuff out of the papers for his benefit and I get nothing in return
Go have a drink and relax!
I haven't drank in six days. I have been abusing alcohol and other things since I didn't get that Boston job. I appreciate you
Like Saban preaches to our players -So what Now what when a disappointment occurs! Get up and dust your shit off! You are too good of a person to spiral down!
